## [Fujifilm Launches instax mini Link+ Smartphone Printer](https://camerajabber.com/photography-news/fujifilm-launches-instax-mini-link-smartphone-printer/)
*Camera Jabber* | 26/01/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: photography, camera

> Fujifilm has announced the release of the instax mini Link+, a portable smartphone printer designed to give users more control, creativity, and convenience when bringing their digital photos to life. As the latest addition to the successful instax mini Link series, the mini Link+ introduces a host of upgraded features through the instax mini Link™ app, combining tactile instant prints with bold, modern design. Whether pulling images from a phone’s camera roll or favourite Pinterest board, the Simple Print mode allows users to print photos on demand. Those looking to fine-tune every shot can explore the new Simulation Mode, which previews how prints will look in various real-world settings—ideal for home décor planning or curated displays. The enhanced Design Print Mode ensures that photos, text, illustrations, and graphics are rendered with sharp detail, while the Frame Print feature allows for the addition of fun overlays, captions, or stickers.
